dedupe_keys.name: mirca os global monthly irrigated and rainfed cropped areas for 2000 2015

description: MIRCA-OS is a global open-source dataset of monthly irrigated and rainfed cropped areas for the start of the 21st century, described in a Scientific Data descriptor. The authors built a library of subnational crop-specific irrigated and rainfed harvested area statistics and combined it with global gridded land cover products to map irrigated and rainfed cropped area at 5 arc-minutes for 23 crop classes for the years 2000 to 2015. Annual and monthly grids are provided as GeoTIFF and NetCDF in WGS84, with crop calendars for irrigated and rainfed crops as CSV for 2000, 2005, 2010 and 2015 giving harvested area and planting and maturity months per spatial unit. Coverage is global. Access is free on HydroShare under CC BY 4.0, with the processing code on GitHub. Caveats: the series stops in 2015, the resolution is about 10 km, and crop areas are harvested areas from statistics distributed over land cover, not mapped fields. Simulation uses: monthly irrigation water demand for supply and reservoir models and drought impact on irrigated crops. Related records: the groundwater irrigation inventory (data-global-groundwater-irrigation-inventory-siebert-2010) and HID (data-hid-historical-irrigation-dataset-1900-2005).
